for budget in (60, 40, 25):
    chunks = chunk_documents(documents, budget)
q: 20 documents, the biggest has 54 tokens. How many chunks with a budget of 60?
why: Every document already fits in the budget, so each one stays a single chunk.

q: With a smaller budget, what happens to the number of chunks and to the biggest chunk?
o: More chunks (43), and none is above 25 tokens
why: A smaller budget means more pieces, and the promise is that no piece is above the budget.

c: hard_split("ตรวจสอบสายเซ็นเซอร์ให้แน่น", 2)
q: Cutting by tokens. Where does it cut the Thai text?
o: Inside a word: สายเซ and ็นเซ are halves of เซ็นเซอร์
why: Tokens are not words. A hard split is only a safety net, for a sentence longer than the whole budget.

q: A budget of zero. What happens?
o: ValueError: max_tokens must be at least 1
One chunk with the whole text
why: An impossible budget is a mistake, so reject it loudly instead of returning something strange.
